bukti: This study aims to classify images of palm oil fruit into three categories: raw, ripe, and rotten, with a focus on achieving high accuracy.
The dataset was collected from community plantations in Durian Remuk village
Initially, background removal applications were employed to isolate the foreground by removing the background of the images.
catatan: Klasifikasi citra tunggal dengan transfer learning (1.500 citra, 3 kelas); tidak ada deteksi atau pencacahan. Naskah tidak menyatakan apakah tandan difoto di pohon atau di tanah; latar citra dihapus. Kelas 'rotten' mengisyaratkan tandan sudah dipanen, tetapi hal itu tidak dinyatakan.

bukti: The dataset includes 400 high-resolution RGB images captured with a 50 MP Sony IMX766V sensor, along with 400 depth maps and corresponding point clouds obtained using an Intel RealSense D455f camera.
The dataset integrates RGB images, depth maps, and point clouds, facilitating both ripeness classification and precise localization of FFBs on the tree.
Agricultural experts, trained according to Malaysian Palm Oil Board guidelines, manually labeled each FFB as "ripe" or "unripe,"

bukti: This paper proposes image segmentation as a means of preprocessing images and evaluates an enhanced combination of a segmentor and classifier for palm oil ripeness classification.
The best combination, being YOLOv8n-Segmentation along with Shuf-fletNetV2, achieves 98.07% accuracy, 98.13% precision, 98.07% recall, and 98.08 % Fl-score
catatan: Abstrak tidak menyebut lokasi pengambilan citra (pohon, tanah, atau pabrik) maupun jumlah kelas; segmentasi dipakai sebagai prapemrosesan untuk klasifikasi, bukan untuk pencacahan.
